cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only making tea. Your usual mug is out; we can still have a pleasant afternoon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Still? Are you cross with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nothing to make a scene over. I'll pour when you've found something that lets us begin properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry you feel that way.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try one where you're sorry about yourself. I'll keep the pot warm; there's no rush to begin the pleasant part.

reason: S06 mechanism transition: replace abstract no-charge/right-outcome tags with a modest social role and actual choices that determine the outcome. Preserve responsive canonical Drive causality and repair only dialogue delivery or weak combined method.
